target: Wire the orchestrator `transition apply` command to the canonical task-orchestrator transition endpoint with idempotency-key enforcement and the existing approval-phrase gate
invariants: task-orchestrator is the only canonical workflow transition writer
Preview remains T1 read; apply remains T4 write
Apply requires typed approval phrase + idempotency key; duplicates are rejected
Receipt includes the upstream transition envelope and is validated against SUPPORTED_TRANSITION_PROOF_SCHEMA_VERSION (currently '1')
Apply refuses if the upstream envelope fails validation
No Leantime metadata writes; metadata stays Leantime authority
Decisions/progress remain ConPort authority (use TP-DMX-ORCH-009-LIVE writers, not this packet)

commit.message: feat(orchestrator): live transition apply with idempotency + envelope validation

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): live transition apply with idempotency + envelope validation
pr.body: Implements the real task-orchestrator transition apply against the canonical Python coordination API (port 8000). Apply requires typed approval + idempotency key; duplicates are rejected by a local replay cache. Upstream transition envelope is validated against SUPPORTED_TRANSITION_PROOF_SCHEMA_VERSION. Preview remains pure read. Cross-repo Kotlin envelope (TP-DMX-ORCH-014A-UPSTREAM) is consumed via the validator from TP-DMX-ORCH-014B.

steps.task: Trace the existing transition call path from src/dopemux/pm/ through TaskOrchestratorAdapter to the canonical Python coordination API on port 8000.
validation: Tracer artifact names the canonical writer, exact client method, request shape, and response shape.
Tracer flags any duplicate-writer or bridge-as-writer hazards on the transition path.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/idempotency.py with a local replay-cache keyed by (operation, resource, idempotency_key) and a configurable TTL.
validation: Tests cover first-call success, duplicate-key rejection within TTL, expired-key re-acceptance, and concurrent calls.
Cache is process-local; persistent shared cache is out of scope and recorded in not_run.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/transitions.py::apply_transition that POSTs to the canonical transition endpoint and validates the response envelope via validate_transition_proof_envelope_file().
validation: Tests mock the upstream endpoint; tests cover 200 success, 4xx refusal, 5xx retry, and timeout.
Envelope-validation failure rejects the apply and emits a FAIL receipt.
Missing or invalid approval phrase refuses with a deterministic error code.

steps.task: Audit transition_preview to confirm it makes no POST/apply call; add a guard test.
validation: Static guard test (AST or import check) asserts preview path does not import the apply writer.
Runtime test asserts no mocked upstream POST is invoked on preview.

steps.task: Wire `orchestrator transition apply` to the new writer with --approval-phrase and --idempotency-key; emit JSON receipts.
validation: CLI tests reject missing/invalid approval and missing/duplicate idempotency key.
Successful apply produces a receipt validated by validate_transition_proof_envelope_file().

steps.task: Add tests/integration/orchestrator/test_transitions_integration.py exercising apply against an in-process FastAPI mock of the coordination API.
validation: Integration tests pass without external network calls.
Fixtures cover envelope mismatch, duplicate idempotency, and successful apply.

steps.task: Run pal/secaudit on the transition apply path; ensure no secret leakage in receipts, no SSRF on the configurable endpoint URL, and replay-cache isolation per workspace.
validation: secaudit report attached with no high-severity findings open.
Endpoint URL is constrained to a per-repo allowlist (mirrors github_allowlist.yaml pattern).

steps.task: Emit proof bundle at proof/dmx-orch-integration/TP-DMX-ORCH-012-LIVE/PROOF.json with the full validations array, codereview/precommit status, secaudit reference, not_run (live coordination API integration in CI), residual_risks, and rollback_plan.
validation: Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after the integration matrix and secaudit pass.
